tessl_attack_vectors.evidence: 9 explore_* nodes + reproduce all fail at 9-11 each in same 30d window. High covariance suggests they share a downstream dependency (likely base worktree state, common parent).
tessl_attack_vectors.invariant_opportunity: Add a parallel-fanout shared-failure detector: when N sibling nodes fail with overlapping fingerprints (same error hash, same metadata_json prefix), classify as 'shared dependency failure' not 9 independent defects. Reduce noise in CXDB.

tessl_attack_vectors.evidence: gate_es has 36 'error' + 22 'failure' all-time. Error vs failure distinction is critical: 'error' = infra (Claude process died, network), 'failure' = substantive (verdict=fail). CXDB doesn't currently cluster these.
tessl_attack_vectors.invariant_opportunity: Healer cluster should split 'error' from 'failure' before reporting; the user's diagnostic pattern (per MEMORY.md) was to distinguish infra crashes from real defects. Without the split, Healer recommends patches for infra issues.

tessl_attack_vectors.evidence: gate_skeptic fails 7/30d. Skeptic verdict is a load-bearing input to vendor waivers (verifier.rs:1009). 7 skeptic failures in 30d = 7 beads stuck at vendor-waiver path. Each blocked bead is a missed merge.
tessl_attack_vectors.invariant_opportunity: Skeptic gate should be at the TOP of the risk ladder, not the middle. A flake here can block everything; needs a fallback chain (cold_reviewer retry, then codex, then human). Per MEMORY.md Coder pipeline missing fallbacks (2026-08-20 rev-tj5qh/rev-a8t5l/rev-k8hp4) this is a known gap.

tessl_attack_vectors.evidence: __run_end__|exhausted = 6 in 30d. v4 circuit breaker fires on 3 consecutive exhausted runs. 6 exhausted runs in 30d suggests the breaker is firing every ~5 days, not catching a one-off.
tessl_attack_vectors.invariant_opportunity: Add a Healer pre-flight check: when circuit breaker trips, write the LAST-3-RUNS' node outcomes + metadata to a structured breaker-trip.md for the next session to read before relaunch. Without this, every breaker-fire loses context.

tessl_attack_vectors.evidence: cold_reviewer:error = 3 in 30d. These are likely 429s. MEMORY.md notes 'CodeRabbit rate-limited + BugBot usage-limited' caused ironclad audit matrix failure (2026-08-17).
tessl_attack_vectors.invariant_opportunity: Before launching cold_reviewer fan-out, probe a 1-agent canary (per swarm skill rule 4 rate-limit resilience). Probe failure = use human-review fallback, not 'just retry'.

last_30_days.cluster_summary: Two failure modes dominate: (1) parallel-fanout shared-failure covariance (9-11 per node, 9 sibling nodes), and (2) load-bearing gate flakes (gate_skeptic, gate_es) cascading into vendor-waiver path. Both are candidates for Tessl-style invariants: (1) -> P2 analytics dashboard with shared-failure clustering; (2) -> P3 risk-ladder with gate-skeptic at the top tier + fallback chain.
